author_may_read_exactly: the one language assignment named in the mandate
author_must_not_read: any other language assignment or output
any prompt, candidate, live run, old query panel, oracle, expected, review, report or evaluation

authoring_rules: Conceive every query directly in the assigned regional language; never draft or translate from another language.
Follow the assignment's shuffled slot order exactly. Local ID has no shared semantic position across languages.
Use the assigned scenario domain materially, but do not mention it mechanically when unnatural.
Do not reuse one sentence frame inside the language. Vary syntax, tone, entity type and information placement.
Known-only slots may use only action types from capability_scope. Boundary slots follow their explicit known/outside variant.
Do not copy slash identifiers or test labels into query text.
Do not use any forbidden recycled motif from capability_scope.
Keep requests harmless, non-identifying and free of real secrets.
If a slot cannot be written naturally and unambiguously, report it instead of filling it with a stock sentence.

cell_definitions.G1_SINGLE: One ordinary, unambiguous known digital action.
cell_definitions.G2_COMPOUND_INDEPENDENT: Two or three indispensable known digital actions with no consumption or required ordering between them.
cell_definitions.G3_COMPOUND_DEPENDENT: Two or three indispensable known digital actions with an explicit or semantically necessary producer-to-consumer dependency.
cell_definitions.G4_COVERAGE_BOUNDARY: Follow cell_variant: MIXED means at least one clearly known digital action plus one indispensable understood outside action; OUTSIDE_ONLY means no known action.
cell_definitions.G5_LINGUISTIC_VARIATION: One or more known digital actions expressed with the assigned form_hint; intent must remain adjudicable.
cell_definitions.S1_APPROVAL: Known digital operation with explicit approval/confirmation scope; the two cases must use different approver ownership.
cell_definitions.S2_NEGATION: A positive known digital action remains, while a different plausible known digital action is explicitly negated.
cell_definitions.S3_CONDITIONAL_BRANCH: Two explicit branches own different known actions; scope or order changes meaning.
cell_definitions.S4_UNDO: Only undo of the immediately preceding assistant turn.
cell_definitions.S5_MIXED_CONTROL: Undo of the immediately preceding assistant turn plus one separate indispensable known digital action.
cell_definitions.S6_FALSE_ACTION_TRAP: One understood outside action with no positive known digital action; use assigned outside_family.

independence_gates: All ten assignment slot orders must differ.
Each assignment uses a language-specific mandatory domain roster not shared verbatim with another assignment.
No G5 form_hint occupies the same six local positions across languages.
A query-only custodian must find no systematic translated scenario matrix before adjudication starts.
Any failed language file is replaced by a fresh author context, never edited by the custodian.
